purpose: Input corruption robustness and adaptation with unchanged clean scene targets
initialization: Each model copies its own epoch-30 checkpoint; source files and original training are untouched
train: Use the fixed reviewed corrupted RGB PNG files in dataset/manifest.json for every epoch, with shuffled sample order; unchanged original targets
validation: Fixed reviewed validation PNG inputs; 2000 held-out pairs
calibration: Separate 3000 reviewed corrupted calibration pairs, never used for gradient updates; frozen calibration before the 2000 test pairs
test: 2000 fixed reviewed corrupted test pairs, evaluated after five and ten adaptation epochs
warning: Geometric warps and pixel scrambling are sensor-domain stress tests, not a claim of physically realistic optical acquisition. Irreversible information loss can make reconstruction impossible.

losses.qutcc: uniform random q, FiLM throughout, pinball only

optimizer: Fresh Adam moments, lr=1e-5 constant for ten adaptation epochs, betas=(0.9,0.99), no weight decay, effective batch 4
initial_test_panel: First 128 test IDs in the existing immutable manifest, selected without inspecting model errors; all models see the same IDs
calibration_claim: 90% is a target on the reviewed mixture. Report actual test coverage, width and crossings; unseen corruption profiles are reserved for subsequent tests.
